_doc: Blueprint §7 routing table, as configuration (Continuation Plan Stage 4). Hermes owns model SELECTION; agents ask for a slot, never a model id. Override any slot per run with WFACT_ROUTE_<SLOT>=anthropic:<model-id> (e.g. WFACT_ROUTE_INTAKE). Only slots actually read through packages/hermes/src/routing.ts are listed — the Phase 4 builder/evaluator split and Hermes-lite's own model are still chosen in their packages' modelClient.ts, a tracked gap (PROGRESS.md), not silently implied here. Prices re-verified 2026-09-28 against the Claude API pricing table; re-verify before relying on them. Stage 5: `models` is the ONE per-model price table every cost figure is computed from (costForModel in src/routing.ts) — replacing the per-CLI PRICING constants.

intake.why: Blueprint §5 Task intake: fast/cheap tier (Claude Haiku 4.5) — classification + extraction, high volume, low judgment.

planner.why: Blueprint §5 Planning: mid-tier reasoning (Claude Sonnet-class) — stage breakdown and template choice need real judgment, not the frontier tier.
